what: float64 exact diagonal of the empirical neural tangent kernel of PDE residual rows, diag_b = |dr_b / d theta|^2 over every weight, bias and readout parameter of deep tanh MLPs with D > H, regime diag = (r, diag). Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_gram.projected_residual_ntk_diagonal: the first-layer part |dr_b / dW_1|^2 from the projected cotangents (q_b x_b^T + Q^F_b Omega + Q^V_b V^T) without forming the H x D row, hidden layers by the per-layer rule of the full-seed module. The claim regime D / H >= 64 was fixed on separate calibration cells (an earlier calibration at D / H = 5-32 had given 1.2-1.9x over the explicit first-layer rows); the three controls have D / H = 8, 21 and 32. The ablation 'projected streams with explicit first-layer rows' is the strongest control by construction in the claim regime; the other tiers are the full-seed stream identity without the projection, vmap(grad) through the projected Laplacian, explicit rows from the shared streams, and per-row forward-Laplacian and Taylor-mode engines
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's diag program on a reduced instance (width 4, D_q = min(D, 5) > 4 so the projection is active, B = 4 interior points (+ 1 boundary point), same depth and operator, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (Taylor series per coordinate direction, no projection, J by central differences in every parameter, diag = row norms): r and diag 1e-12 + 1e-10 max |ref|; the candidate and its explicit-first-layer ablation pass both under the rule and with the identity forced on every hidden layer; full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.projected_streams_explicit_first_layer_r: the same projected streams and cotangents, the first-layer rows formed explicitly at H D per row; the module's own ablation
tiers.full_seed_stream_identity: deep_residual_ntk_diagonal on the full-seed streams, no projection
tiers.explicit_rows_from_shared_streams: the full J from one reverse pass of the summed residual, row norms; full-seed streams_J
tiers.per_row_forward_laplacian: vmap(grad) through one-point forward-Laplacian engines: rg_lib stream recursion, omnibias.jax.laplacian.deep_field_value_grad_laplacian, folx.forward_laplacian; row norms

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning

full_size_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
